page_title: SAS 1-0 CRE | Sassuolo v Cremonese 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Cremonese.
90+3' Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
90+3' The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The offside statistics – 4:3.
90' The linesman signals that Romano Floriani (Cremonese) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

87' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle and it's Romano Floriani (Cremonese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. It's a free kick to Sassuolo, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
86' Flag up against Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
83' It is time for a substitution. Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) is on for Ismael Kone.
81' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Francesco Folino (Cremonese) replacing Filippo Terracciano.
81' That's the end of the game for Matteo Bianchetti, who is replaced by Mikayil Faye (Cremonese).
79' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
79' Cremonese are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
77' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
76' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) prepares to take a corner kick.
74' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) picked up a yellow card from referee.
74' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) makes a strong challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul. Sassuolo have a free kick.
72' Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
71' Fabio Grosso prepares a substitution. Luca Moro is replaced by Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo).
71' Armand Lauriente comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo).
70' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

69' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top left corner only for Emil Audero to dive and make a save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sassuolo.
68' Giuseppe Collu couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) and blew his whistle. Sassuolo are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alberto Grassi as he is replaced by Romano Floriani (Cremonese).
65' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) takes the corner.
65' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The referee points to the corner flag and Cremonese will take a corner.
64' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) picks up a yellow card.
63' Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Giuseppe Collu signals. That's a free kick to Cremonese.
62' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
61' Wonderful movement by Cremonese. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
59' Substitution. Luca Lipani is replaced by Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo).
59' Fabio Grosso decides to make a substitution. Alieu Fadera will be replaced by Domenico Berardi (Sassuolo).
58' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
57' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) heads on.
56' Great teamplay by Sassuolo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

55' Luca Moro (Sassuolo) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
54' A pass by Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
51' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:4.
50' Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' Sassuolo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
47' Cremonese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Davide Nicola makes a switch. Dennis Johnsen (Cremonese) is coming on in place of Tommaso Barbieri at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Giuseppe Collu starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' The game is interrupted. Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Cremonese, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
42' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) commits a rough foul. Giuseppe Collu stops the game and makes a call. Sassuolo will take a free kick.
41' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
39' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese).
39' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo).
36' Cremonese will kick-off.

36' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cremonese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' Neat passing move from Cremonese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
34' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
34' The ball goes out of play. Cremonese are awarded a corner kick.
32' The yellow card is received by Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese).
31' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
30' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
28' The game is interrupted now, Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Cremonese have been awarded a free kick.
26' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) finds some space for a shot after collecting the ball and unleashes a rocket of a shot from long distance towards the net. The goalkeeper thwarts the effort.
25' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul. Sassuolo are awarded the free kick.
24' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
23' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Michele Collocolo (Cremonese) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Alessio Zerbin.

21' Cremonese slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
20' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
20' 5:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
18' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
15' Cremonese failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' Michele Collocolo (Cremonese) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball is out of play. Cremonese win a corner kick.

14' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Arijanet Muric pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
13' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) was too forceful with his tackle and Giuseppe Collu interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Sassuolo have a free kick.
10' A pass by Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The linesman signals a throw-in for Sassuolo.
7' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
6' The Cremonese players are exchanging some short passes.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

3' A neat pass is well received by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
2' A decent save by Emil Audero. Luca Moro (Sassuolo) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
1' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emil Audero, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Sassuolo will have the kick-off.
Giuseppe Collu is introduced as the referee for today's match.
